transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been having terrible trouble sleeping lately and can't seem to get any rest. I keep having these awful nightmares, and I've just been feeling extremely stressed and on edge all the time. It's really wearing me down.
Can you tell me more about these nightmares, are they related to a specific event or experience that you've had?

Yes, they are definitely related to a very traumatic event I experienced about three weeks ago. I keep reliving that awful situation in my dreams over and over again, and it wakes me up in a complete panic.
How have you been feeling and coping since the traumatic event, and have your symptoms been consistent over the past three weeks or have they changed in any way?

I've been struggling constantly every single day since it happened three weeks ago, and I'm really not coping well. The sleep issues, the intrusive memories, and my constant irritability have stayed exactly the same and haven't improved at all.
Have your symptoms lasted for more than a month, or are we still within that initial month since the traumatic event occurred?
No, it hasn't been a month yet. We are still within that first month, as the event happened exactly three weeks ago. The symptoms started right after and have been going on since then.
How much have these symptoms been interfering with your daily life, such as your work, relationships, or ability to perform usual activities?

I'm not quite sure, to be honest, and I haven't really thought about how much it's affecting my daily routine yet. I've just been so focused on trying to get through each day that I haven't really paid attention to how it's impacting my work or relationships.

Since your symptoms have been present for three weeks and you're still within the first month after the traumatic event, can you think of any changes or improvements in your symptoms that might happen if they were to continue beyond this initial month?

I'm really not sure and I haven't thought about how things might change or improve in the future. Right now, I'm just struggling to cope with my symptoms as they are today, and it's hard to think beyond that.
Do you think you would be able to manage your symptoms and daily life if they were to persist for several months, or do you think your condition would significantly worsen over time?

I'm honestly not sure how I would manage, and the thought of this continuing for months is terrifying. I am just so overwhelmed by my daily lack of sleep and constant distress right now that I can't even think about the future. I really don't know what would happen to me.

Given that your symptoms have been present for three weeks and are still within the initial month after the traumatic event, it seems likely that you are experiencing Acute Stress Disorder, as the symptoms have not yet persisted for more than a month, which would be more characteristic of Posttraumatic Stress Disorder.

That makes complete sense, and yes, it has been exactly three weeks since the traumatic event happened. I understand the distinction you are making between Acute Stress Disorder and PTSD based on this timeline. I'm just relieved to have a name for what I've been going through.
